name: Barbecued Buzzard Wings
summary: Rigglefuzz swears by barbecued buzzard wings, a rich sauce on tangy meat. Everything for a batch is on hand except the wings themselves. Fetch enough of them and Rigglefuzz may part with the recipe.

sections.title: A Local Favorite
sections.body: Rigglefuzz is proud of barbecued buzzard wings. The sauce is rich, the meat tangy, and the aroma carries to hungry folk a long way off. Every ingredient for a batch is already in hand, all but the wings. Bring four buzzard wings, and Rigglefuzz might share the recipe.

faq.q: Who asks for the buzzard wings?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz wants buzzard wings to cook a batch of barbecued buzzard wings.

faq.q: What does Rigglefuzz offer in return for the wings?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz hints at sharing the recipe if you bring enough wings.

faq.q: Why does Rigglefuzz need buzzard wings?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz has everything else needed for a batch of barbecued buzzard wings, and only the wings are missing.

faq.q: How many wings does Rigglefuzz want?

angles.text: Cooks take note: the recipe for the dish is on offer.
